name: session-bar
description: A bar under the prompt with compact, clear, effort, model and a color per folder, plus a side chat for quick questions that don't interrupt the task.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the panel, the bar and the notes the model receives. auto follows the `language` setting of Claude Code, or your system locale: Spanish stays Spanish, anything else is English.

folderColors.title: Folder colors
folderColors.description: Pin a color to each project: a comma-separated list of <text the path contains>=<color>, e.g. "api=cyan, shop=purple, docs=orange". Colors: red, green, blue, yellow, purple, orange, pink, cyan. Other folders get a stable color of their own, never one of the pinned ones.

persona.title: Side chat persona
persona.description: One sentence added to the standalone side chat's instructions, e.g. "The user is a cardiologist: answer clinical questions at specialist level."

keepDefaults.title: Bar clicks: this session only
keepDefaults.description: Claude Code saves /effort and /model as the default for new sessions. "on": after each click on the bar, this mod puts back the previous default in ~/.claude/settings.json (keys model, effortLevel and modelSettings, right away and again 6.5 s later), so the click changes this session only. A change another session saves to those same keys in that window can be lost. "off" (default): a click saves the default just like typing the command, and the mod never writes settings.json.
